meta.title: Location Store — where who-is-where is written down
meta.subtitle: each process writes its own address, and another process reads it to connect

components.label: Location Store
components.sublabel: an external store such as Redis

cards.title: Why no address goes into a configuration file
items: Each process writes its address and the names it serves into the Store at startup, and refreshes that record while it lives. The record disappears when it stops.
The caller reads the Store to find where to connect. Adding servers or restarting one at a different address changes nothing on the calling side.
Which node a Spot or Actor is on right now is recorded here too. A Store is required in order to use Spots and Actors.
